accuracy_notes.companion_video: This is a different creator's labeled route. Its numbers and timestamps are NOT interchangeable with the primary video's.
accuracy_notes.null: Not established by the available source text; not a claim that no puzzle or coordinate exists.
accuracy_notes.coordinate_format: The two numeric triples below are reproduced exactly as reported by a player. Axis labels and correspondence to video stops are unverified.

regional_checklist.note: A video's numbered stops can include collectibles and activities other than supply chests.

steps: Find the item at the companion-video timestamp.
Open it if accessible; if sealed, inspect nearby enemies or interactables.
inspect_and_open.limitation: The chapter label supplies no more specific unlock condition.

steps: Approach carefully because a Blobfly can flee.
Attack it, using a ranged attack if needed.
Locate the Tidal Heritage at the listed timestamp.
Interact with it; clear nearby guards first if it is sealed.
claim_tidal_heritage.limitation: Individual guards or combat conditions are not specified in the chapter list.

steps: Find and attack the nearby training dummies.
If activating all of them does not finish the puzzle, check the surroundings for an order clue.
Inspect the color-match puzzle shown at 01:54 in the companion video.
Match its displayed color pattern to unlock the advanced chest.
Activate the target challenge.
Use a ranged attack to hit every spawned target; obey any timer shown in-game.
Check the companion video at the item's timestamp for the precise environmental trigger.
hidden_trigger_unverified.warning: Do not assume that every chest labeled 'hidden' comes from breaking the same kind of object.

steps: Find the glowing Mutterfly.
Follow or guide it to its destination.
Check for a spawned chest or the next Mutterfly.
Solve the nearby training-dummy interaction to obtain its chest.
Collect the nearby Torn Page as a separate pickup if present.
training_dummy_and_separate_page.warning: The chapter title mentions both activities; it does not establish that collecting the page unlocks the chest.

steps: Activate the challenge.
Complete the objective displayed in-game before its timer expires.
Collect the resulting chest.
Find the breakable rock shown at the timestamp.
Attack and destroy it.
Check the exposed or newly spawned chest.
Search the cliff south of Clouded Cliffs overlooking Memento Square.
Break all three rocks at the cliff edge.
Collect the chest that appears.
Go to the stone dragon in Gorges of Spirits.
Collect one Sonance Casket at its mouth.
Climb to the area immediately above its head for the other.
Find the holographic viewpoint telescope.
Interact with it to register the scenery.
Look for a nearby mechanism creating grapple points.
Activate it and use the grapple route.
Check its destination for the hidden chest.
Attack the cube from the side that moves it in the desired direction.
Move it along the highlighted conveyor arrows.
Guide it onto the glowing blue destination tile.
If a holographic wall blocks it, check for a connected switch.
Interact with a Corroder so it follows you.
Lead it into the obstructing Spike to destroy that Spike.
Find another Corroder for each additional Spike.
Open the revealed advanced chest.
Use the Levitator to pick up nearby Key Repeaters.
Place and orient them so their emitted pulses illuminate every required tile.
Open the unlocked chest.
Locate the three Mutterflies shown beginning at 22:14.
Guide each to its destination.
Claim the advanced supply chest after completing the group.

quest_locked_chest_plan.start_area: Makeshift camp near Clouded Cliffs and its Resonance Nexus
steps: Approach Patrol Officers Cunren and Lingdi and listen to their conversation.
Set in-game time to 12:00.
Talk to Lingdi and agree to help raid the Exile-occupied camp.
Follow the quest markers and rescue the hostages.
For the final two locked cells, insert the available Induction Cells into their Cell Sockets.
Defeat the Exiles, including those in the camp center and elevated area.
Talk to Cunren to finish the quest; check the camp for its associated premium chest.

optional_torn_page_plan.purpose: Collect four pages to start Tales of the Past and Present: Gorges of Spirits; do not treat this as a confirmed prerequisite for the training-dummy chest.
locations: Above the highest scaffolding behind Jué's statue in Memento Square.
Inside the first building left of the stairs when entering the Clouded Cliffs base from its Resonance Nexus; on a crate.
On top of the watchtower beside that building.
On top of an unmarked watchtower east of Clouded Cliffs.
optional_torn_page_plan.after_collecting_all_four: Take them to the Storyteller in Jinzhou.
